modmenu.summaryTranslation.lets_start_to: Gather in a lobby first, then enter the world together.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.lets_star:
"I'm not even in yet, why did you guys start?"
"Relax, we're just chopping some wood. Hurry up, it'll be dark soon!"
Maybe there's always someone in your group whose connection is slow, and they just can't get in for a while. But everyone else is already in, and if you don't start playing...
This mod is here to fix that! Start only once everyone is in: no more falling behind, and no more worrying about time passing while you wait. awa

config.lets_start_together.head_size.too: 8 to 256, in the unit below. Default 64 pt. Pages are added when the screen is full.
config.lets_start_together.head_size_uni: Pixels are real screen pixels and ignore GUI Scale. 1 point = 1 GUI pixel and scales with GUI Scale.
config.lets_start_together.show_names.to: Show player names under the heads. When off, hover a head to see the name.
lets_start_together.button.create_multip: You can switch between single-player and multiplayer any time. Later, find this world in Singleplayer.
